# QR export disabling guards both UI entry points and code generation

This landing adds a default-enabled QR-export preference. A truthy DisableQRExport policy calls setAndLockPref(false), Settings removes the pane/category during initialization, and the module rejects getQRCodes before loading account data when the preference is false. Main-menu, app-menu and Settings refresh at different times. The imported helper implementation and native policy lifecycle remain bounded dependencies; no runtime or universal data-protection guarantee is established.

Scope: QRExport enterprise policy and UI.
